person.name: Galia Kropach
person.intro: I design interfaces and build them. Ten years of front-end engineering, a background in architecture and visual communication, and a habit of shipping things end to end — from the first Figma frame to the deployed app.

projects.name: Lega11y
projects.description: Scans a site and reports where it falls short of accessibility and legal compliance standards. Built to make the audit automatic instead of a checklist someone works through by hand.

projects.name: CFP Manager
projects.description: A full-stack tool for managing speaking submissions: OAuth sign-in, calendar and mail integrations, and deduplication across sources that list the same call twice.

projects.name: Math Kingdom
projects.description: A bilingual English and Hebrew math adventure for curious kids aged 8+. Explore an illustrated kingdom through playable adventures in infinity, primes, fractals, probability, Fibonacci, topology, and graph theory, with a journal that records discoveries and progress.

projects.name: First Rule
projects.description: A village with no rules, and the children who have to write them. A game about how democratic processes actually come about. In progress.

projects.name: World Cup Galaxy
projects.tagline: Bilingual World Cup app for kids
projects.description: A bilingual Hebrew and English World Cup app for children, with match data, quizzes, score predictions, and a sticker album. Built for kids to explore independently or with their parents, with support for multiple player profiles on a shared device.

projects.name: 8 Queens
projects.description: Place eight queens on a chessboard so that no two share a row, column, or diagonal. A puzzle about patterns, constraints, and finding a solution.

projects.name: AI Experience Kit
projects.tagline: Hands-on AI learning for parents and kids
projects.description: A bilingual English and Hebrew kit for exploring AI together. Three browser mini-games cover AI detection, training a classifier, and building prompts, alongside 11 guided activities families can try together.

projects.name: Just Dancing
projects.description: Follow Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes and get real-time feedback on your moves. A dance-along game using a Teachable Machine pose model and TensorFlow.js to recognize movement through your webcam.
